notes.text: Page-wide controls always on screen: the GUI control should be fixed so that variants can be toggled on different previews anywhere on the page for better back-and-forth comparisons.
Pixel-perfect previews: the iframe previews throw off anything related to size; never zoom, scale or transform a specimen whose size is being judged.
More real UI: live production components and whole real pages as the comparison surfaces, not a screen of specimens.
The app's UI is open: any UI that touches the app in an active lab track may be worked on before the dedicated app agents get to it later.
Dark and light are chosen separately; dark applies to marketing and the app's dark mode, light to paper and the app's light mode. Argue the theming model from the ground up.
Feels like a research report without applicable takeaways; synthesise the spill doctrine and placements into it; the section configurator for aurora placements is the promising part.
Show the voices in use on production UI across marketing and the app; every comparison must show the distinction.
Pivot to discovery and sourcing: a few potential sources rather than exact picks.
